posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: At what point do you want it to activate? If it's okay at turn start, you can just make a base troop event that checks if an actor is affected by that state and then fire those projectiles with the VS plugin commands in the troop event.

posts.author: SamThePengwyn
posts.body:
at the Start of the turn is fine but sorry for asking but i need a bit more information to understand it completely~
can i use the one i´ve posted above or do i need something els entirely? like~ do i put an VS Action sequence into that or how do i do that coz right now its just not doing anything.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Make a troop event in troop 1 (it's set as default as a base troop for VisuStella Battle Core, so it activates for all troops). Make it activate every turn. There you have conditionals to check if your actors are affected by the state. If they are you play an animation on an enemy (you can roll for random enemy and make conditionals // use VS projectiles for the fireballs if you want). And then you reduce the enemy hp. That was my suggestion.

posts.author: SamThePengwyn
posts.body:
Allllright. That worked. Thanks!
two short questions tho~
If i want to have multiple of such a.e. an Ice / lightning / etc i just have to put 'em on a new page right?
Is there a way to check if "user" has the state or must it be a specific actor?
Thanks in advance :>

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
You can also check the other states on the same page if you want.
And you can check your battle members in the conditional script, so they can be any actors. If you have max 4 battle members, you check four (put Xs to 0, 1, 2, 3 + change stateId to number):
$gameParty.battleMembers()[X] && $gameParty.battleMembers()[X].isStateAffected(stateId)
